name: SOC 2 Trust Service Criteria
description: Starter Trust Service Criteria map for SOC 2 style assessments at hackathon fidelity.

controls.name: Control environment
controls.description: The organization demonstrates a commitment to integrity and ethical values and builds expectations into policies and communications.

controls.name: Communication and information
controls.description: Communication supports the functioning of internal control internally and externally with relevant audiences.

controls.name: Logical access
controls.description: Logical access safeguards restrict access for employees, contractors, customers, vendors, partners to authorized boundaries.

controls.name: System operations
controls.description: Security incidents are monitored, anomalies analyzed, escalation paths defined with timely restoration efforts.

controls.name: Change management
controls.description: Changes impacting customer commitments require authorization testing approval documentation segregation between environments appropriately.
